transcript: Most people today are desperate to find love. They search everywhere, in people, in apps, in attention, hoping someone will finally make them feel whole. But let me tell you a quiet truth that most hearts forget. You don't find love by chasing it. You find love by becoming someone who no longer needs to chase. When you are lonely inside, you reach for anything that feels warm. When you are unsure of your worth, you accept any love, even the kind that hurts you. And when your heart is afraid to be alone, you settle for a cage and call it home. Most people are not looking for love. They are looking for relief. Relief from emptiness, from fear, from the feeling of not being enough. But love is not relief. Love is recognition. Love is two whole beings who meet, not two half-souls trying to complete each other. So, my friend, before you search for love, sit with yourself. Learn your heart. Heal your wounds. Find peace in your own company. Because the moment you stop needing love is the moment you become magnetic to it. Desperation blinds the heart, but a peaceful soul. That is where real love begins. If you feel this in your heart, my friend, and you're ready to stop chasing love and start healing the parts of you that keep choosing the wrong people, I created a 30-day healing journey to guide you. Every day you receive a short teaching, a simple practice, and gentle guidance to reconnect with yourself. When you heal within, the love you attract changes. You can join the journey through the link in my profile. I will walk with you step by step.
